topic: EU Budget and Ukraine Aid Dispute

en.title: EU budget dispute escalates as four countries resist linking aid to Ukraine funding
en.dek: Slovak PM Fico calls German Chancellor Merz's demand 'blackmail' over EU budget and Ukraine aid
facts: Slovak PM Fico calls German Chancellor Merz's demand 'blackmail' over EU budget and Ukraine aid,Politico Europe, Euronews, The Straits Times
Four EU countries resist German demand to tie budget approval to Ukraine funding,Politico Europe, Euronews
Russian drone attack kills two in Ladyzhyn, western Ukraine on 10 November,The Kyiv Post, NZZ
Negotiators from Russia, Ukraine and US begin two-day peace talks in Abu Dhabi on 10 November,NPR, Fox News
body: Slovak Prime Minister Robert Fico accused German Chancellor Friedrich Merz of "blackmail" over the German demand to link approval of the European Union's next long-term budget to fresh financial support for Ukraine, according to Politico Europe and Euronews.
Four EU countries are reportedly resisting the German demand, Euronews reported, while The Straits Times cited Fico's statement that the demand constituted blackmail.
Russian drones killed two people in the city of Ladyzhyn in western Ukraine on 10 November, damaging civilian infrastructure and energy facilities in the Vinnytsia region, according to The Kyiv Post.
Negotiators from Russia, Ukraine and the United States began a two-day session in Abu Dhabi on 10 November, focusing on security guarantees and territory disputes, according to NPR and Fox News.
The Abu Dhabi talks follow earlier rounds of U.S.-mediated negotiations, including sessions involving Jared Kushner and Steve Witkoff, as reported by NPR.
The dispute over the EU budget comes as Germany pushes for conditions on Ukraine aid, with Chancellor Merz arguing that budget approval should be contingent on continued support for Ukraine.
en.context: German Chancellor Friedrich Merz has sought to tie approval of the EU's next long-term budget to fresh financial support for Ukraine, a position that has drawn resistance from several member states including Slovakia.

en.headline: Russia, Ukraine and US officials hold peace talks in Abu Dhabi
en.body: Negotiators from Russia, Ukraine and the United States began a two-day session in Abu Dhabi on 10 November. According to NPR and Fox News, the talks focus on security guarantees and territory disputes.

it.headline: Russia, Ucraina e funzionari statunitensi tengono colloqui di pace ad Abu Dhabi
it.body: I negoziatori di Russia, Ucraina e Stati Uniti hanno iniziato una sessione di due giorni ad Abu Dhabi il 10 novembre. Secondo NPR e Fox News, i colloqui si concentrano sulle garanzie di sicurezza e sulle dispute territoriali.

fr.headline: Des responsables russes, ukrainiens et américains tiennent des pourparlers de paix à Abou Dabi
fr.body: Des négociateurs russes, ukrainiens et américains ont entamé une session de deux jours à Abou Dabi le 10 novembre. Selon NPR et Fox News, les discussions portent sur les garanties de sécurité et les différends territoriaux.

zh.headline: 俄罗斯、乌克兰和美国官员在阿布扎比举行和平谈判
zh.body: 来自俄罗斯、乌克兰和美国的谈判代表于11月10日在阿布扎比开始了为期两天的会议。据美国国家公共电台（NPR）和福克斯新闻报道，会谈重点在于安全保障和领土争端。

pt.headline: Responsáveis da Rússia, Ucrânia e EUA realizam conversações de paz em Abu Dhabi
pt.body: Negociadores da Rússia, Ucrânia e Estados Unidos iniciaram uma sessão de dois dias em Abu Dhabi a 10 de novembro. Segundo a NPR e a Fox News, as conversações centram-se em garantias de segurança e disputas territoriais.

ja.headline: ロシア、ウクライナ、米国の当局者がアブダビで和平協議
ja.body: ロシア、ウクライナ、米国の交渉担当者は11月10日、アブダビで2日間の協議を開始した。NPRおよびフォックスニュースによると、協議は安全保障上の保証と領土問題を焦点としている。

ko.headline: 러시아, 우크라이나, 미국 당국자들 아부다비서 평화 회담 개최
ko.body: 러시아, 우크라이나, 미국의 협상단이 11월 10일 아부다비에서 이틀간의 회담을 시작했다. NPR과 폭스 뉴스에 따르면 이번 회담은 안보 보장과 영토 분쟁 문제에 초점을 맞추고 있다.

de.headline: Russland, Ukraine und US-Vertreter führen Friedensgespräche in Abu Dhabi
de.body: Unterhändler aus Russland, der Ukraine und den Vereinigten Staaten begannen am 10. November eine zweitägige Sitzung in Abu Dhabi. Laut NPR und Fox News konzentrieren sich die Gespräche auf Sicherheitsgarantien und Gebietsstreitigkeiten.

es.body: Negociadores de Rusia, Ucrania y Estados Unidos comenzaron una sesión de dos días en Abu Dabi el 10 de noviembre. Según NPR y Fox News, las conversaciones se centran en garantías de seguridad y disputas territoriales.

en.headline: Russian drone attack kills two in Ladyzhyn
en.body: Russian drones killed two people in the city of Ladyzhyn in western Ukraine on 10 November, according to The Kyiv Post. The attack damaged civilian infrastructure and energy facilities in the Vinnytsia region.

it.headline: Attacco di droni russi uccide due persone a Ladyzhyn
it.body: I droni russi hanno ucciso due persone nella città di Ladyzhyn, nell'Ucraina occidentale, il 10 novembre, secondo il Kyiv Post. L'attacco ha danneggiato le infrastrutture civili e gli impianti energetici nella regione di Vinnytsia.

fr.headline: Une attaque de drones russes fait deux morts à Ladyjyn
fr.body: Des drones russes ont tué deux personnes dans la ville de Ladyjyn, dans l'ouest de l'Ukraine, le 10 novembre, selon le Kyiv Post. L'attaque a endommagé des infrastructures civiles et des installations énergétiques dans la région de Vinnytsia.

zh.headline: 俄罗斯无人机袭击导致拉德任市两人死亡
zh.body: 据《基辅邮报》报道，11月10日，俄罗斯无人机在乌克兰西部的拉德任市造成两人死亡。此次袭击破坏了文尼察地区的民用基础设施和能源设施。

pt.headline: Ataque de drones russos mata duas pessoas em Ladyzhyn
pt.body: Drones russos mataram duas pessoas na cidade de Ladyzhyn, no oeste da Ucrânia, a 10 de novembro, segundo o The Kyiv Post. O ataque danificou infraestruturas civis e instalações energéticas na região de Vinnytsia.

ja.headline: ロシアのドローン攻撃、ラディジンの2人が死亡
ja.body: キーウ・ポスト紙によると、11月10日、ウクライナ西部の都市ラディジンでロシアのドローン攻撃により2人が死亡した。この攻撃により、ヴィーンヌィツャ州の民間インフラとエネルギー施設が損傷した。

ko.headline: 러시아 드론 공격으로 라디진에서 2명 사망
ko.body: 키이우 포스트에 따르면 11월 10일 우크라이나 서부 라디진시에서 러시아 드론 공격으로 2명이 사망했다. 이번 공격으로 빈니차 지역의 민간 기반 시설과 에너지 시설이 파손되었다.

de.headline: Russischer Drohnenangriff tötet zwei Menschen in Ladyschyn
de.body: Bei einem russischen Drohnenangriff auf die Stadt Ladyschyn in der Westukraine kamen am 10. November zwei Menschen ums Leben, wie die Kyiv Post berichtet. Der Angriff beschädigte zivile Infrastruktur und Energieanlagen in der Region Winnyzja.

es.headline: Un ataque con drones rusos mata a dos personas en Ladyzhyn
es.body: Drones rusos mataron a dos personas en la ciudad de Ladyzhyn, en el oeste de Ucrania, el 10 de noviembre, según The Kyiv Post. El ataque dañó infraestructura civil e instalaciones energéticas en la región de Vínnytsia.
